verdict.rationale: The only webhook mention in the evidence is webhooks as a step inside multi-step workflows for external system integration. That is an adjacent workflow feature, not documented file or content change notifications that push to a developer. Nothing in the evidence covers event subscriptions, signature verification, or retry semantics, so this applicable axis earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, file events push to me — documented webhooks/change notifications fire when content changes, with verification and retry semantics spelled out
